reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly reports the synthesis of Pd@PdAg icosahedra and truncated bi-pyramids with identical facets/compositions but different surface strains (0.3% vs 2.1%), demonstrates superior EOR activity/durability for the 0.3% strained form, and uses DFT to attribute this to a lowered d-band center and reduced *CH3CO adsorption energy. All key premises are explicitly supported by this single, accurately represented source.
premises: Pd@PdAg nanocrystals with identical composition and facets but different surface strains can be synthesized
Surface strain of ~0.3% vs ~2.1% is the sole structural difference governing EOR performance
Lower surface strain (~0.3%) downshifts the d-band center of PdAg alloy
Downshifted d-band center reduces adsorption energy of key intermediate *CH3CO
Reduced *CH3CO adsorption energy enhances ethanol oxidation activity and selectivity
